mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profile (user_id, target_region, birth_date, monthly_income, asset_amount, job_status, target_sgg_code, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetRegion}, #{birthDate}, #{monthlyIncome}, #{assetAmount}, #{jobStatus}, #{targetSggCode}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE target_region = VALUES(target_region), birth_date = VALUES(birth_date), monthly_income = VALUES(monthly_income), asset_amount = VALUES(asset_amount), job_status = VALUES(job_status), target_sgg_code = VALUES(target_sgg_code), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
